name: Anki
title: Anki: free Quizlet alternative
hook: Quizlet charges you thirty six bucks a year to study with flashcards. This app does it for free.

features.say: Rate each card, and it schedules the next review for when you're about to forget it.
Make your own cards with images and audio, and sync them for free.

caption:
Quizlet Plus charges $35.99/year. Anki helps you remember anything for free 🧠

✅ Spaced repetition shows each card right before you'd forget it
✅ Cards with images and audio
✅ Free sync across your devices
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux (Android via the free AnkiDroid app)
ℹ️ The official iPhone app, AnkiMobile, is the one paid exception.

Comment "STUDY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #studytok #studytips #flashcards #students #freeapps #techtips
